references.text: The elders of Gilead ask Jephthah to be their leader and fight against the Ammonites, continuing their request from verse 6.
Gilead's leaders promised that whoever would lead the fight against Ammon would become head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
Jephthah accepted the offer and was made head and commander over the people of Gilead.
The elders of Israel asked Samuel to give them a king who could lead them in war, similar to the situation where the elders of Gilead asked Jephthah to lead them.
Moses was asked to choose leaders for the tribes, corresponding to how Gilead chose Jephthah as their leader.
Confirms that Jephthah actually became judge over Israel after he accepted leadership over Gilead.
